# New for musivum: the commands that testdata/reference_output_test.go runs on LiveKit's
# selectors and reference_test.rs on the port. One command a line:
#
#   new null|simulcast|vp9|dd      a new selector
#   from simulcast|vp9|dd          New...FromOther of the selector there is
#   start 0|1                      SetEnableStartAtDesiredQuality
#   max S T, seen S T, target S T, current S T, req S
#   maxspatial S, maxtemporal T, seenspatial S, seentemporal T
#   tls none|null|vp8              SetTemporalLayerSelector
#   rollback
#   pkt L S T K M F                Select of a packet of layer S/T as layer L; K: key frame,
#                                  M: marker, F: the VP9 flags among UBEP, "." for none of
#                                  them, "-" for a packet without VP9 header
#   tpkt T K M F                   SelectTemporal of a packet of temporal layer T; F: of the
#                                  VP8 header K (key frame), S and Y, "." for none, "-" for
#                                  a packet without VP8 header
#
# Every command gives one line of output, named by the number of its line here.

# simulcast: from nothing, latching on to the first key frame and stepping up
new simulcast
max 2 2
seen 2 2
target 2 2
req 2
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 1 0 0 -
pkt 0 0 1 1 0 -
pkt 0 0 0 0 1 -
pkt 1 1 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 2 1 0 -
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 -
pkt 2 2 0 1 1 -
pkt 2 2 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
rollback
pkt 2 2 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 0 0 1 -

# simulcast: stepping down needs a key frame
new simulcast
max 2 2
seen 2 2
current 2 1
target 0 1
req 0
pkt 2 2 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 0 0 0 -
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
pkt 2 2 0 1 0 -
pkt 0 0 2 1 1 -
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 -

# simulcast: overshoot dialed back at a key frame at or below the maximum
new simulcast
max 1 2
seen 2 2
current 2 2
target 2 2
req 1
pkt 2 2 0 0 0 -
pkt 2 2 0 1 0 -
pkt 1 1 1 1 0 -
pkt 2 2 0 1 0 -
pkt 0 0 0 1 1 -
rollback
maxspatial 0
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -

# simulcast: the target follows the layer that is latched when it is the highest seen
new simulcast
max 2 2
seen 1 2
target 2 2
req 2
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
seenspatial 2
target 2 2
pkt 2 2 1 1 0 -
maxtemporal 1
seentemporal 1

# simulcast: starting at the desired quality
new simulcast
start 1
max 2 2
seen 2 2
target 2 2
req 2
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
pkt 2 2 1 0 0 -
pkt 2 2 1 1 0 -
target 0 2
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
current -1 -1
target 1 2
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -
start 0
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -

# a selector made from another keeps its layers
new null
max 2 3
seen 1 1
target 1 1
req 1
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -
from simulcast
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -
from vp9
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 B
pkt 0 1 1 1 0 UB
from dd
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 -
from simulcast
pkt 1 1 0 1 0 -
from simulcast
rollback

# vp9: starting, scaling up at the start of a frame
new vp9
max 2 2
seen 2 2
target 2 2
req 2
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 -
pkt 0 1 1 0 0 B
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 B
pkt 0 0 0 1 0 .
pkt 0 0 0 1 1 E
pkt 0 1 0 1 0 BP
pkt 0 1 0 1 0 B
pkt 0 1 0 1 1 E
pkt 0 2 0 1 0 .
pkt 0 2 0 1 1 EP
pkt 0 0 1 0 0 B
pkt 0 0 1 0 0 UB
pkt 0 0 2 0 0 U
pkt 0 0 2 0 0 UBE
pkt 0 1 2 0 0 BE
pkt 0 2 2 0 0 BE
pkt 0 2 2 0 1 EP

# vp9: scaling down at the end of a frame
target 0 0
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 B
pkt 0 1 0 0 0 B
pkt 0 2 2 0 0 E
pkt 0 1 0 0 0 BE
pkt 0 0 1 0 0 BE
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 BEP
rollback
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 BE
target 1 1
pkt 0 1 1 0 0 UB
pkt 0 1 0 0 0 E
target -1 -1
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 BE
current -1 -1
target 1 0
pkt 0 2 1 1 0 B
pkt 0 0 0 0 0 E

# temporal layers of VP8 under the simulcast selector
new simulcast
max 2 3
seen 2 3
current 1 0
target 1 2
tpkt 0 0 0 .
tls vp8
tpkt 1 0 0 -
tpkt 1 0 0 S
tpkt 2 0 0 SY
tpkt 1 0 0 Y
tpkt 1 0 1 SY
tpkt 3 0 0 SY
tpkt 2 0 0 SY
tpkt 2 0 1 .
target 1 0
tpkt 2 0 0 SY
tpkt 2 0 1 .
tpkt 1 0 0 SY
target 1 3
tpkt 3 1 0 K
tpkt 4 1 0 KS
tpkt 0 0 0 KS
target 1 1
tls null
tpkt 3 0 0 .
tls none
tpkt 3 0 0 SY
rollback
